classification.difficultyReason: Complete descending-power tables by dividing by the base through zero into reciprocal values. The exponent sequence and division arrows scaffold the method; the other bases repeat the same taught procedure.

inlines.text: Divide by 2 each time the exponent decreases by one. For a positive integer
Divide by 3 each time the exponent decreases by one. For a positive integer
Divide by 5 each time the exponent decreases by one. For a positive integer
Divide by 10 each time the exponent decreases by one. For a positive integer
